title: Save your money
text: Save your money. Had try keep trying for over 15 frustrating minutes until it was perfectly lined up with metal in between, perfect amount of pressure so it would rotate, and don’t let anything bump that button a 2nd time bc it turns off very easily & you have to start all over again. My left arm & hand are paralyzed so with only one useable hand I thought this would be a life saver. Unfortunately there were no reviews to give guidance.
